### analytics
- Analytics is configured by administrators under Settings → Analytics and reported at `/admin/analytics`. It sends anonymous aggregate GA4 data only; never pass user IDs, names, email addresses, secrets, or sensitive values to analytics events.
- Track application goals with `trackAnalyticsEvent` from `$lib/analytics`. Public and signed-in product pages are included by default; customize sensitive routes in the owned `$lib/analytics.config.ts`.
- Consent Mode v2 runs in advanced mode, so denied analytics storage can still produce cookieless pings. Keep the application privacy notice accurate and leave a visible way to reopen analytics consent settings.

instructions: Run migrations: bun run --cwd apps/api migration:run
Configure GA4 under /admin/settings, test the connection, and open /admin/analytics for reports.
Disable GA4 Enhanced measurement history-based page changes to prevent duplicate SvelteKit page views.
Document advanced consent mode in the application privacy notice: denied analytics storage can still send cookieless pings.
